## Alcoa Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release and Conference Call


09/15/2026


Download PDF Format (opens in new window)


PITTSBURGH--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Alcoa Corporation (NYSE: AA; ASX: AAI) plans to announce its third quarter 2026 financial results on Thursday, October 15, 2026, after the close of trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Alcoa will host a conference call to discuss the third quarter 2026 financial results on October 15, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. EDT (October 16, 2026, at 8:00 a.m. AEDT). The call will be webcast live via[Alcoa's website,](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.alcoa.com&esheet=54603975&newsitemid=20260914249546&lan=en-US&anchor=Alcoa%27s+website%2C&index=1&md5=8aeee7cd3a57769779901e49e131d8c6)[www.alcoa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.alcoa.com&esheet=54603975&newsitemid=20260914249546&lan=en-US&anchor=www.alcoa.com&index=2&md5=33b39eed3c5726d0ede377ce298f612e) .


The third quarter 2026 earnings press release with financial results, and a related presentation, will be available on the “Investors” section of Alcoa’s website,[www.alcoa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.alcoa.com%2F&esheet=54603975&newsitemid=20260914249546&lan=en-US&anchor=www.alcoa.com&index=3&md5=e0fefa9bda723999466a75d562122a4e) . A link to the press release will also be on Alcoa’s X handle @Alcoa at[www.X.com/Alcoa](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.X.com%2FAlcoa&esheet=54603975&newsitemid=20260914249546&lan=en-US&anchor=www.X.com%2FAlcoa&index=4&md5=6cfda9fea42d53974c3b0ecbf34e1b3f) .


**Conference Call Information**


**Time:**


Thursday, October 15, 2026: 5:00 p.m.–6:00 p.m. EDT


Friday, October 16, 2026: 8:00 a.m.–9:00 a.m. AEDT


**Hosts:**


William Oplinger, President and Chief Executive Officer


Molly Beerman, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer


**Webcast:**


Go to the “Investors” section of the[Alcoa website](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.alcoa.com%2F&esheet=54603975&newsitemid=20260914249546&lan=en-US&anchor=Alcoa+website&index=5&md5=3b2ab0262f7e7224839fd2e7f92fddb3) to listen only and view presentation slides.


**Call:**


+1 (877) 883-0383 (Domestic)


+1 (412) 902-6506 (International)


Conference ID: 5195547

**About Alcoa Corporation**


Alcoa is a global industry leader in alumina and aluminum products with a Vision to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. Since developing the process that made aluminum an affordable and vital part of modern life, our talented Alcoans have developed breakthrough innovations and best practices that have led to greater safety, efficiency, sustainability and stronger communities wherever we operate.


**Dissemination of Company Information**


Alcoa intends to make future announcements regarding company developments and financial performance through its website,[www.alcoa.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.alcoa.com%2Fglobal%2Fen%2Fhome&esheet=54603975&newsitemid=20260914249546&lan=en-US&anchor=www.alcoa.com&index=9&md5=fb24db42735cfc307911da73c5eff675) , as well as through press releases, filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission, conference calls, media broadcasts, and webcasts. Alcoa does not incorporate the information contained on, or accessible through, its corporate website or such other websites or platforms referenced herein into this press release.
